title: Asymptotic Behavior of Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2610.19358v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper we study the behavior of transformer networks generating text over long periods of time. We show that even a three-token, single-layer attention-only transformer can fail to converge. We then study a rich class of transformers with arbitrary finite depth, layer normalization, MLPs, RoPE encodings, and an arbitrary mix of local and global layers. Every transformer in this class has a softmax temperature threshold above which its empirical cache distribution converges to a unique limit, independent of initial conditions. We show further that, while each transformer has a temperature threshold, the supremum of this set is infinite, so there is no global minimal temperature that forces all transformers to converge.

translated_abstract: 本文研究了Transformer网络在长时间生成文本时的行为。我们证明，即使是一个仅有三个词元、单层的纯注意力Transformer也可能无法收敛。随后，我们研究了一类丰富的Transformer模型，它们具有任意有限深度、层归一化、多层感知机（MLP）、RoPE编码以及局部层与全局层的任意混合。该类中的每个Transformer都存在一个softmax温度阈值，当温度超过该阈值时，其经验缓存分布会收敛到一个唯一的极限，且该极限与初始条件无关。我们进一步证明，尽管每个Transformer都拥有自己的温度阈值，但这组阈值的上确界是无穷大的，因此不存在一个能够强制所有Transformer都收敛的全局最小温度。
tldr: 本文证明了一类包含层归一化、MLP和RoPE编码的Transformer在softmax温度超过各自阈值时，其经验缓存分布会收敛到与初始条件无关的唯一极限，但由于这组阈值的上确界为无穷大，不存在能强制所有Transformer收敛的全局最小温度。
en_tdlr: For a rich class of transformers with layer normalization, MLPs, and RoPE encodings, the empirical cache distribution converges to a unique, initial-condition-independent limit once the softmax temperature exceeds a per-model threshold, yet since the supremum of these thresholds is infinite, no global minimal temperature guarantees convergence for all transformers.
